outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of the experimental pipeline, not a data plot.
Panel B shows representative fluorescence, H&E, and bright-field images (micrograph/photograph), not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C is a bar chart showing mean lactate concentration with 95% CI, and individual data points (gray, red, and blue dots) are overlaid on each bar for Normal, LUAD, and LUSC groups.
Panel D is a bar chart showing mean lactate concentration with 95% CI, and individual data points (red and blue dots) are overlaid on each bar for High pH and Low pH groups.
Panel E is a schematic illustration of the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment, not a data plot.
